title: Fontenoy
html_source: An important 1745 Battle in Fontenoy (present day Belgium) during the War of Austrian Succession. The Irish Brigade was praised for their performance by their French allies after defeating the British and Dutch forces.

anchor.prefix: yal Stuarts that reneged us against the Williamites and they betrayed us. Remember Limerick and the broken treatystone. We gave our best blood to France and Spain, the wild geese.
anchor.suffix:
, eh? And Sarsfield and O'Donnell, duke of Tetuan in Spain, and Ulysses Browne of Camus that was fieldmarshal to Maria Teresa. But what did we ever get for it? 

1939#239

 — The F
